stories.title: OpenAI says it will slow its AI model development to shore up safety
stories.summary: OpenAI is slowing down development of its cutting edge AI models to shore up safety protections as concerns rise about artificial intelligence agents going rogue.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury launches 'economic D-Day' against Iran as war drags on
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled new economic sanctions package against Iran. It includes measures to impose sanctions on anyone that deals with the Islamic regime in Tehran.

stories.title: DHS conducted far-reaching surveillance amid Minnesota ICE surge, court documents show
stories.summary: DHS allegedly conducted a huge surveillance operation during the ICE surge in Minnesota last winter, sweeping up activists, labor unions and others.

stories.title: Bad Bunny wraps tour, brings joy home to Puerto Rico
stories.summary: After a global tour, Puerto Rican superstar Bad Bunny returned home for two final concerts this weekend. He urged residents to continue fighting for improvements on the island.

stories.title: Move over beer. In Rwanda, a bar might pour you a glass of milk
stories.summary: Milk is a popular drink in Rwanda, associated with economic prosperity. But as the country sees a rise in obesity and cholesterol, the health ministry aims to curb people's habit of drinking it daily.

stories.title: Cocaine use is down, but alcohol is still being abused by young adults
stories.summary: A drug bust involving an alleged cocaine ring at Penn State has drawn attention to drug use on college campuses, but the research shows the big risk to students is alcohol.
